channel.description: Latest articles from The Christian Post (christianpost.com)

item.title: Marth Green, Conn. church founder who championed female pastors, dies at 102
item.description: Martha V. Green, a beloved Connecticut pastor who founded St. Mary’s Unison Free Will Baptist Church in New Haven in 1973 and championed other women to follow in her footsteps, died on Valentine’s Day at the age of 102. #MaryGreen #Connecticut #Pastor #102

item.title: Trump endorses GOP rival of Texas pastor who ran against him in 2024
item.description: As early voting gets underway in Texas, President Donald Trump has thrown his support behind a U.S. Air Force veteran in a crowded GOP primary for a newly redrawn congressional district. #Texas #PresidentDonaldTrump #2026Election

item.title: Muslim man stabs son to death for accepting Jesus Christ as his Savior
item.description: A Muslim in Uganda stabbed his son to death with a long knife for converting to Christianity last month. #Uganda #persecution #Islam #Christianconvert #murder

item.title: Middle school lesson plan tells students ICE uses 'tricky & violent tactics': report
item.description: A Minnesota middle school lesson plan for eighth-graders asks students to consider whether Immigration and Customs Enforcement officers have gone “too far,” claiming that the agency is arresting legal immigrants and U.S. citizens, who have reportedly been "dragged, tackled, beaten, tased and shot.” #DefendingEducation #ICE #Trumpadministration #immigrationpolicies #deportation

item.title: Nations pledge to contribute billions, troops to Gaza at Trump's Board of Peace launch event
item.description: Leaders from around the world gathered in Washington to discuss the future of the war-torn Gaza Strip, with some nations pledging as much as $1 billion toward infrastructure and redevelopment. #BoardofPeace #Israel #Gaza #DonaldTrump

item.title: Babylon Bee CEO urges Christians to produce 'more good books' to push back against bad ideas
item.description: In his speech at the National Religious Broadcasters 2026 International Christian Media Convention at the Gaylord Opryland Resort & Convention Center in Nashville, Babylon Bee CEO Seth Dillon began by acknowledging that the mission had changed. #BabylonBee #NRB #Satire #Evangelicals #SethDillon

item.title: 4 things to know about the Rhode Island shooting, trans-identified gunman Robert Dorgan
item.description: Within the span of one week, dozens of people have been killed or injured in two separate attacks in the United States and Canada committed by males who publicly identified as transgender. Here are four things to know about the latest shooting in Rhode Island. #RhodeIsland #LGBT #TransgenderViolence

item.title: BBC presenter finds Jesus after daughter's mental health crisis
item.description: David Harper considered himself agnostic when he started investigating Christianity after his daughter became a Christian and overcame debilitating depression. What started as a research project examining the evidence for God culminated in Harper falling to his knees one day as he fully accepted Jesus. #Christianfaith #Christianity #bornagainChristian #apologetics

item.title: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth slams 'godless left,' links founding of US with Christian principles
item.description: In a keynote speech laden with biblical references and patriotic fervor, Secretary of War Pete Hegseth addressed the National Religious Broadcasters' Freedom 250 Celebration by drawing a direct line from the Bible to the founding of the United States. #PeteHegseth #NRB #ChristianNationalism

item.title: Christians face 'scapegoating,' rising arrests in Iran amid political upheaval: 'Horrifying'
item.description: A joint annual report released this week highlighting rights violations in Iran warned that 254 Christians were arrested in the country in the Muslim country because of their faith last year, and that Christians increasingly face "scapegoating" as they are blamed and targeted amid political tensions. #Iran #persecution #Islam
